label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter 'param' flows through HashMap storage/retrieval to become 'bar', which is concatenated directly into SQL query string (SQL injection) and also reaches HTML output sinks (XSS). The ESAPI encoder mitigates XSS but does not prevent SQL injection - both vulnerabilities exist on the reported path.

evidence.note: User input 'param' extracted from request parameters and passed to inner class
Parameter stored in HashMap and retrieved back as 'bar' variable
Concatenated user input into SQL query string causing SQL injection vulnerability
